text:
morgan: Quick a11y pass on the new model selector and the tuning modal — a few things I ran into

sam: thanks for looking. what did you see?

morgan: 1) Tabbing into the modal works, but after closing via Esc the focus doesn't return to the original 'Tune model' button — focus lands at top of the page. that's a keyboard trap-ish UX.

morgan: 2) When the live token-cost badge updates (streaming responses), there's no polite announcement. screen readers miss the dynamic cost change. should be in a aria-live region.

jess: Re: focus return — we should store document.activeElement when opening and restore on close. simple and consistent with other modals.

ashley: For the live cost: agree on aria-live; prefer aria-live="polite" to avoid interrupting speech during generation. also consider announcing the new total only when generation finishes, not every token.

sam: Good call. Also noticed the model dropdown items are virtualized. NVDA stops reading list items when focus moves quickly. We may need to expose aria-posinset/aria-setsize on each item and ensure role="option" + aria-selected are present.

morgan: Also contrast: the muted helper text in the right rail (12px) is 3.2:1 against the surface — failing for small text. Recommend using the 14px neutral or boost contrast to 4.5:1 for small helper copy.

jess: I can make a patch: increase color to neutral-600 for small text and bump size to 13 if layout allows.

ashley: One more: the 'Reset to defaults' button in settings looks like plain text. Needs visible focus ring (prefer not to rely on outline:none in our reset). We should follow the focus styles in the design tokens (blue-500 3px shadow + 2px offset).

morgan: Agree. Also check that focus is applied to any custom control (slider for temperature). keyboard users couldn't hit the thumb easily with just arrow keys — aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax should be present on the slider and it should support PageUp/PageDown for larger steps.

a11y-bot: automated-scan results: 5 issues found in /console/model-tune modal — 2 contrast, 1 focus management, 1 missing aria-live, 1 role/virtualization. See /a11y/reports/1766005123 for details.

sam: I'll draft a small spec: store opener, restore focus, add aria-hidden toggles, add aria-live region for streaming summary, expose aria attributes for virtualized list, and update styles for contrast + focus.

jess: tagging @frontend for sizing impact. I'll push a PR for color + focus ring first.

morgan: Thanks — can we aim to ship the focus management + aria-live in this sprint? those are highest impact.

ashley: yep, I can take focus management and aria-live. assigning to me.

sam: I'll do the virtualization/ARIA props and coordinate with eng-runtime on streaming announcements to avoid spamming screen readers per token.

morgan: Awesome. small follow-up: add a keyboard shortcut doc entry for 'Skip to main content' in the console (global). helps users who land deep in nav.

ashley: noted. will add to the keyboard nav page in docs.

morgan: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
